Covering $[m,99]$ (which has $100-m$ distinct values) with $m-1$ positions requires $m-1\ge100-m$, i.e. $m\ge51$. For a fixed $m$, the sum is minimized by the "flat-then-rise" walk: start at $m$, linger at $m$, then climb by $1$ each step to $99$ at position $m-1$.
